_about: The practice green and the driving range. green_cost and range_cost are what they cost to build, and green_upkeep and range_upkeep are the monthly bills. A visitor who putts on the practice green pays nothing; green_mood is how much satisfaction rises, before personality and the difficulty slider. A bucket on the range costs bucket, charged once on arrival and booked as range income, and range_mood is the satisfaction rise. The short grass in front of the bays is drawn on the range's own tile and claims no ground.
